result.instructions: Tools for Planable, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which posts are scheduled for next week on our Instagram page?"; "Create a draft post for tomorrow with this text and send it to approval."; "What are the metrics for our LinkedIn page over the last 30 days?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Planable data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run planable_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run planable_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run planable_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. planable_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: planable_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces this token can access, with their timezone, approval settings and labels. Start here to get a workspaceId. Planable API: GET /workspaces.

tools.name: planable_list_pages
tools.title: List connected pages
tools.description: List the social pages (accounts) connected to a workspace, with their network and id. Use the page ids in planable_list_posts and planable_create_post. Planable API: GET /pages.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: planable_get_page_metrics
tools.title: Get page metrics
tools.description: Get follower and engagement metrics for one connected page over a date range (up to 90 results per call). Planable API: GET /pages/{id}/metrics.

page_id.description: Page id (from the matching list tool).

startDate.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601 date-time.

endDate.description: End of the range, ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: planable_list_members
tools.title: List workspace members
tools.description: List the members of a workspace (name, role and id). Use a member id as an approver in planable_request_post_approval. Planable API: GET /members.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: planable_list_posts
tools.title: List posts
tools.description: List posts in a workspace, optionally filtered by page, campaign, scheduled or created date range. Returns status, approval state, scheduled time and text. Planable API: GET /posts.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id (from the matching list tool).

pageId.description: Only posts on this page id.

campaignId.description: Only posts in this campaign id.

scheduledAfter.description: Only posts scheduled after this ISO 8601 date-time.

scheduledBefore.description: Only posts scheduled before this ISO 8601 date-time.

createdAfter.description: Only posts created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

createdBefore.description: Only posts created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: planable_get_post
tools.title: Get a post
tools.description: Get one post with its text, media, labels, scheduled time, status and approval details. Planable API: GET /posts/{id}.

post_id.description: Post id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: planable_get_post_metrics
tools.title: Get post metrics
tools.description: Get the engagement metrics of one published post. Planable API: GET /posts/{id}/metrics.

post_id.description: Post id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: planable_list_post_comments
tools.title: List post comments
tools.description: List the internal comments on one post (team discussion, not public comments). Planable API: GET /posts/{id}/comments.

post_id.description: Post id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: planable_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns of a workspace, optionally by status. Planable API: GET /campaigns.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: planable_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign with its dates, status, description and links. Planable API: GET /campaigns/{id}.

campaign_id.description: Campaign id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: planable_list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List the labels of a workspace. Use label names in planable_create_post. Planable API: GET /labels.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: planable_list_media
tools.title: List media
tools.description: List the media uploads in a workspace library (images and videos, with their ids and URLs). Planable API: GET /media.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id (from the matching list tool).

deletable.description: Only media that the token may delete, when true.

tools.name: planable_get_media
tools.title: Get a media upload
tools.description: Get one media upload by id, with its status and URL. Planable API: GET /media/{id}.

media_id.description: Media id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: planable_create_post
tools.title: Create a post draft
tools.description: Create a post draft in a workspace. The post follows the workspace approval settings: it is not published by this call. Give pageIds or pageId to choose the connected pages. Planable API: POST /posts.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id (from the matching list tool).

scheduledAt.description: Planned publish time, ISO 8601. Omit to leave it unscheduled.

firstComment.description: Text of the first comment, where the network supports it.

teamOnly.description: Mark the post as team-only (hidden from clients).

tools.name: planable_update_post
tools.title: Update a post
tools.description: Change the text, schedule, labels, media, first comment or campaign of an existing post. Approval fields cannot be set here. Planable API: PATCH /posts/{id}.

post_id.description: Post id (from the matching list tool).

scheduledAt.description: New publish time, ISO 8601. Null removes the schedule.

labels.description: Label ids or names (replaces the list).

firstComment.description: New first comment text. Null removes it.

campaignId.description: Campaign id. Null removes the campaign.

tools.name: planable_request_post_approval
tools.title: Request post approval
tools.description: Send a post to approvers in its workspace approval flow. This does not approve the post. Planable API: POST /posts/{id}/request-approval.

post_id.description: Post id (from the matching list tool).

approverIds.description: Member ids of the approvers (from planable_list_members).

levelId.description: Approval level id, when the workspace uses levels.

tools.name: planable_add_post_comment
tools.title: Add a post comment
tools.description: Add an internal comment to a post, or reply to one comment. Clients see it only when the post is not team-only. Planable API: POST /posts/{id}/comments.

post_id.description: Post id (from the matching list tool).

replyToCommentId.description: Comment id to reply to (from planable_list_post_comments).

tools.name: planable_create_label
tools.title: Create a label
tools.description: Create a coloured label in a workspace. Planable API: POST /labels.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id (from the matching list tool).

text.description: Label text shown on the label.

tools.name: planable_upload_media
tools.title: Upload media from URLs
tools.description: Upload 1 to 20 public image or video URLs into a workspace media library. Each file is limited to about 100 MB. Planable API: POST /media.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id (from the matching list tool).

mediaUrls.description: Public image or video URLs (1 to 20).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Planable
prompts.description: What you can do with Planable here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_the_scheduled_posts_of_a_page
prompts.title: Review the scheduled posts of a page
prompts.description: List the workspaces to get the workspace id. Then list the posts filtered by page and scheduled date, and open one post.

prompts.name: check_the_metrics_of_a_page
prompts.title: Check the metrics of a page
prompts.description: List the connected pages, then read the follower and engagement metrics of one page over a date range.

prompts.name: draft_a_post_and_send_it_to_approvers
prompts.title: Draft a post and send it to approvers
prompts.description: Create a post draft that follows the approval settings. Then request approval from the approvers. The tools do not publish or approve the post.

prompts.name: upload_media_and_create_a_label
prompts.title: Upload media and create a label
prompts.description: Upload public image or video URLs to the media library. Then create a coloured label to tag the posts.

prompts.name: discuss_a_draft_with_the_team
prompts.title: Discuss a draft with the team
prompts.description: List the internal comments on a post. Then add a reply. Clients see it only when the post is not team-only.
